title: The Velvet Hour
source: New for the Music Lab (Claudette), Oct 25 2026

parts.name: Bass
parts.description: Root on one, fifth on three: the bossa's slow heartbeat.

parts.name: Percussion
parts.description: Shaker, rim clave, a soft low drum; congas when it's fuller.

parts.name: Melody
parts.description: The long-breathed tune (A B A, A), a light solo, a coda.

parts.name: Countermelody
parts.description: Low answers in the tune's long notes -- and the interlude's solo.

parts.name: Strings
parts.description: Held chords: under the bridge, the solo, the last A and the coda.
